text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, at the training track...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I've been observing you, and based on
what I've
seen, your advice is not only
sound, but also
highly effective.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
As such, I shall honor you with the
special
privilege of giving me advice.
You have one
minute to tell me
something useful.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Oh? It's not often you get the
opportunity to
exchange words with
someone as illustrious as
me, you know!
choice_data_list: こっちもトレーニング中なんだけど……
choice_data_list_en: I'm in the middle of training too, though...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
It would be rather foolish of you not to
take
advantage of such a chance.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It looks like she's not going to let me go
unless I
give her some kind of advice, so
I try to think of
something to say.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Oh? What an intriguing question. I must
say, it
makes for a fine discussion point.
choice_data_list: 昨今の根性論について討論する
仕掛けるタイミングについて話す
choice_data_list_en: Discuss the timing to make a move

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, King Halo and I discuss the
topic for a
while.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I appreciate your subject of choice.
Timing is
critical when making a final
spurt in the
homestretch!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
And it's that very skill that serves as my
ultimate
weapon! Allow me to tell you
all about it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, King Halo and I discuss the
topic for a
while.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Goodness, look at the time! I must be
going now.
